S2R policy evaluation in simulation (remote policy server).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config_path CONFIG_PATH
                        configs/eval YAML; flags override it
  --arm ARM
  --scene SCENE
  --task TASK
  --unit UNIT           arm calibration unit ID
  --variant VARIANT     Task variant (eval, eval_dr, ...)
  --disable_fabric      Disable fabric and use USD I/O operations.
  --num_envs NUM_ENVS   Number of environments to simulate.
  --seed SEED           Environment seed
  --num_episodes NUM_EPISODES
                        Number of episodes to evaluate
  --policy_timeout_ms POLICY_TIMEOUT_MS
                        Policy request timeout; increase for CPU inference
                        (default 15000 ms).
  --rename_map RENAME_MAP
                        JSON sim camera -> policy camera map, e.g.
                        '{"realsense_rgb": "room"}'
  --policy POLICY       Policy plugin name (a folder under policies/)
  --policy_option KEY=VALUE
                        Policy-specific client option; repeatable
  --policy_host POLICY_HOST, --host POLICY_HOST
                        Policy server host
  --policy_port POLICY_PORT, --port POLICY_PORT
                        Policy server port (default: the plugin manifest's
                        default_port)
  --policy_api_token POLICY_API_TOKEN
                        Server API token
  --action_horizon ACTION_HORIZON
                        Action steps per query: MolmoAct2 1..30 (default 30),
                        other policies 1..16 (default 16)
  --action_repeat ACTION_REPEAT
                        Control ticks to hold each predicted joint target
                        (default 1)
  --prefetch_steps PREFETCH_STEPS
                        Query P steps early; sim delivers P steps later and
                        drops the first P actions (0: off)
  --blend_steps BLEND_STEPS
                        Cross-fade old unexecuted predictions into new chunks
                        over K steps (0: off)
  --ema_alpha EMA_ALPHA
                        Arm EMA coefficient in (0,1]; 1: off
  --smooth_gripper      Also apply EMA to the gripper
  --temporal_ensemble TEMPORAL_ENSEMBLE
                        Query every M steps and average overlapping
                        predictions, favouring older chunks (0: off)
  --te_decay TE_DECAY   Temporal ensemble weights exp(-k*i), i=0 oldest
  --log_timing          Write per-action CSV and print latency/jerk summary
  --timing_csv TIMING_CSV
                        Timing CSV path (default:
                        outputs/timing/sim_<timestamp>.csv)
  --episode_length_s EPISODE_LENGTH_S
                        Episode timeout in simulation seconds (default:
                        task.toml [task.episode] eval_steps)
  --lang_instruction LANG_INSTRUCTION
                        Language instruction for the policy (default:
                        task.toml instruction)
  --rerun               Enable Rerun visualization
  --smoke-test          Run five episodes with Rerun, without saving
                        evaluation reports, videos or CSVs
  --save_videos         Save room/wrist MP4 videos per attempt
  --video_dir VIDEO_DIR
                        Video output directory (default: beside results JSON)
  --video_encoder {libx264,h264_nvenc}
                        Recording encoder: CPU libx264 or NVIDIA NVENC
                        (requires video driver support)
  --render_warmup RENDER_WARMUP
                        0 (default): render the cameras every control step.
                        N>0: render only the N steps before each policy query;
                        physics is unchanged.
  --eval_set EVAL_SET   Fixed benchmark JSON (overrides num_episodes)
  --splits SPLITS       Comma-separated splits, default all in the file
  --repeats REPEATS
  --smoke-selection {first_five,one_per_zone}
  --smoke-reach-timeout-s SMOKE_REACH_TIMEOUT_S
  --smoke-progress-timeout-s SMOKE_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT_S
  --cube_starts CUBE_STARTS
                        Directory containing episode_*.json cube trajectories
  --start_mode {cycle,random}
  --random_fraction RANDOM_FRACTION
  --robot_start {recorded,default}
                        recorded: arm starts at each episode's recorded first-
                        frame state; default: the scene's calibrated reset
                        pose
  --lang_instruction_by_color LANG_INSTRUCTION_BY_COLOR
                        JSON colour to instruction map
  --results_json RESULTS_JSON
  --resume              Continue completed attempts from --results_json (fixed
                        benchmark only)
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --gripper_latch
  --latch_close_below LATCH_CLOSE_BELOW
  --latch_open_above LATCH_OPEN_ABOVE
  --latch_confirm_steps LATCH_CONFIRM_STEPS
  --latch_release_confirm LATCH_RELEASE_CONFIRM
  --latch_min_hold LATCH_MIN_HOLD
  --latch_dataset LATCH_DATASET
                        Training dataset with meta/info.json and
                        meta/stats.json
  --latch_steady_steps LATCH_STEADY_STEPS
  --latch_steady_max_delta LATCH_STEADY_MAX_DELTA
  --gripper_empty_closed GRIPPER_EMPTY_CLOSED
  --latch_empty_margin LATCH_EMPTY_MARGIN
  --latch_empty_confirm LATCH_EMPTY_CONFIRM
  --latch_reopen_steps LATCH_REOPEN_STEPS
  --log_gripper
  --gripper_csv GRIPPER_CSV
  --seed_per_episode

launcher arguments:
  Arguments for the KitLauncher. For more details, please check the
  documentation.

  --livestream {0,1,2}  Force enable livestreaming. Mapping corresponds to
                        that for the `LIVESTREAM` environment variable.
  --xr                  Enable XR mode for VR/AR applications.
  --device DEVICE       The device to run the simulation on. Can be "cpu",
                        "cuda", "cuda:N", where N is the device ID
  --visualizer VISUALIZER, --viz VISUALIZER
                        Visualizer backends to enable as CSV (e.g.,
                        kit,newton,rerun,viser).
  --verbose             Enable verbose-level log output from the
                        SimulationApp.
  --info                Enable info-level log output from the SimulationApp.
  --experience EXPERIENCE
                        The experience file to load when launching the
                        SimulationApp. If an empty string is provided, the
                        experience file is determined from the resolved
                        visualizer and XR settings. If a relative path is
                        provided, it is resolved relative to the `apps` folder
                        in Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab (in that order).
  --deterministic       Request reproducible rendering (see KitLauncher docs).
  --kit_args KIT_ARGS   Command line arguments for Omniverse Kit as a string
                        separated by a space delimiter. Example usage:
                        --kit_args "--ext-folder=/path/to/ext1 --ext-
                        folder=/path/to/ext2". A single Kit argument works in
                        both forms: --kit_args "--ext-folder=/path/to/ext1" or
                        --kit_args=--ext-folder=/path/to/ext1.
  --anim_recording_enabled
                        Enable recording time-sampled USD animations from
                        IsaacLab PhysX simulations.
  --anim_recording_start_time ANIM_RECORDING_START_TIME
                        Set time that animation recording begins playing. If
                        not set, the recording will start from the beginning.
  --anim_recording_stop_time ANIM_RECORDING_STOP_TIME
                        Set time that animation recording stops playing. If
                        the process is shutdown before the stop time is
                        exceeded, then the animation is not recorded.
  --max_visible_envs MAX_VISIBLE_ENVS
                        When set, caps the nums of envs shown in the launched
                        visualizers.
